name: consort
description: Consort: a Spec-First Branched-Database TDD agent framework for building transactional applications on Lakebase (Databricks' serverless Postgres/OLTP database, not the Delta Lakehouse). A deterministic orchestrator drives role agents through a spec-first design lane and a test-driven build lane whose every cycle runs against a live copy-on-write branch of a real Postgres database, with human-in-the-loop gates that fail closed. For application backends on Postgres, not ETL or analytics. Run /consort:start to launch the workflow.

hooks.command: d="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}"; { [ -n "$d" ] && [ -f "$d/package.json" ] && [ ! -f "$d/node_modules/.package-lock.json" ]; } && { echo 'consort: finishing plugin dependency install (the cached npm ci was interrupted or timed out)...' >&2; ( cd "$d" && npm ci ) || echo 'consort: dependency install failed; run npm ci in the plugin dir manually.' >&2; }; true
